definitionZh: 边角底 CSS 属性将边角区域设置在元素底部。 一个正值使它离邻居更远,而负值使它更近.
sourceDefinition: The margin-bottom CSS property sets the margin area on the bottom of an element. A positive value places it farther from its neighbors, while a negative value places it closer.
